findings.title: Heavy rain is a monsoon problem
findings.caption: 110 days of at least 64.5 mm in 21 years (Open-Meteo, central Mumbai); 96% fall in June-September, most in July.

findings.title: Weather grids miss the extremes
findings.caption: The reanalysis records 26 July 2005 as 69.6 mm, far below the ~944 mm widely reported at the Santacruz gauge. We use rain only to pick and label real heavy days.

findings.title: Reported spots are local bowls, not coastal roads
findings.caption: 7 of 13 reported spots sit lower than the area around them (vs 46% of all roads); their median distance to water is 526 m vs 330 m for all roads.
